subject: Temporary QPS uplift request — launch week capacity & billing options
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara@arcadia.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: spike expected for launch week — temporary qps uplift?

Hi Connor,

We’re doing a regional rollout next Tuesday (June 30) and expect a 6–8x traffic spike for the first 72 hours. Can Redwood provision a short-term QPS uplift for the us-west region? We’re looking for a temporary headroom of ~250 RPS for 72 hours starting 06/30 00:00 PT.

Attached is a short export of our current daily token usage and expected projected traffic pattern. We don’t want throttles during launch, but we also can’t commit to a long-term tier change today.

What pricing options can you offer for: 1) a one-off temporary uplift, 2) a short-term burst credit, or 3) a provisional true-up after the week? Also need any SLA notes since this is customer-facing.

Thanks — Sara
Sara Patel
Head of Platform
Arcadia AI
[Attachment: arcadia-launch-usage.csv (CSV)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@arcadia.ai>
Cc: Alex Wong <alex.wong@arcadia.ai>
Date: 2026-06-29T09:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: spike expected for launch week — temporary qps uplift?

Sara — thanks for the heads up and the usage file. I copied the team internally so we can move fast. Quick answers up top, details below: 1) We can offer a provisional QPS uplift for the 72-hour window with a prorated true-up after the event, 2) Alternatively, we can provide a pool of burst credits that consume as you go (no immediate invoice if consumption stays within credit), 3) For SLA-sensitive endpoints we can route to a higher availability pool during the window; that’s a separate opt-in.

If you want the simplest path, sign the one-page amendment and we’ll enable the uplift at 00:00 PT on 06/30. Two pricing paths we propose: A) Temporary uplift billing: prorated consumption charged at standard rates, with a one-time 20% launch discount on the uplifted tokens; B) Burst credit bundle: prepay a burst credit (e.g., 500k tokens) at a discounted rate that only depletes when used — remaining credits roll into a short true-up ledger.

I’ll loop in Ben and Marissa to confirm discount authority and any procurement prerequisites. Can you confirm exact timezone for the start and whether you want the SLA routing?

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Arcadia launch week — provisional uplift / pricing options (deal AC-9234)

Marissa / Ben,

Forwarding Arcadia’s ask — they need a 72-hour 250 RPS headroom starting 06/30 00:00 PT. Suggested commercial paths: (1) Prorated uplift charged at list with a one-time 20% discount on uplift usage, (2) Burst credit bundle of 500k tokens at 15% discount, unused credits to roll to a short true-up ledger.

Can we approve a discretionary discount on the uplift? This is a time-sensitive launch for a mid-market customer with clear expansion potential (deal AC-9234). If approved, I’ll send the one-page amendment and the DocuSign link. Also flagging SLA routing for product to enable higher-availability pool for the three days.

Thanks,
Connor

On Jun 29, 2026, at 9:46 AM, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Sara — thanks for the heads up and the usage file. I copied the team internally so we can move fast. Quick answers up top...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Arcadia launch week — provisional uplift / pricing options (deal AC-9234)

Connor — ok to approve a one-time discretionary discount but want to limit exposure. Proposal: approve path A with a 25% discount on uplifted usage up to 750k tokens for the 72-hour window. Any consumption above that will bill at list and we’ll do a post-event reconciliation. Require: signed amendment and a PO by 07/05.

Alternatively, the burst credit path is lower operational overhead: approve a 15% discount on a 500k token prepay. If they pick burst credits, we need to confirm whether unused credits auto-roll to month-end or a 30-day ledger. Recommend ledger approach to avoid refunds.

I’ll sign off if Ben confirms procurement terms are OK.

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T12:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Arcadia launch week — provisional uplift / pricing options (deal AC-9234)

All — procurement OK with Marissa’s guardrails. PO required by 07/05 if they pick uplift billing. For burst credits: we’ll accept ledger rollover for 30 days post-launch. I drafted the one-page amendment and uploaded it to Drive (see link) and created a draft DocuSign envelope. I’ll attach the draft PDF in the external message so they have the exact wording.

Draft DocuSign: https://docusign.com/recipient/ABC123-signature
Drive draft: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A1b2c3d4e

Ben Carter
Sr. Manager, Commercial Ops

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@arcadia.ai>, Alex Wong <alex.wong@arcadia.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-30T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: spike expected for launch week — temporary qps uplift?

Sara / Alex — good news: internal approval secured. Outline below and next steps: 1) Option 1 (Prorated uplift + discount): Redwood will enable the 250 RPS uplift in us-west for 72 hours starting 06/30 00:00 PT. Uplifted consumption will be billed post-event at standard rates with a one-time 25% discount on uplifted tokens for up to 750k uplift tokens. PO required by 07/05. 2) Option 2 (Burst credit bundle): Purchase a 500k token burst credit at 15% off; unused credits will roll into a 30-day ledger for reconciliation. 3) SLA routing: We’ll route named endpoints into the higher-availability pool for the window at no additional latency surcharge, but uptime SLAs remain subject to the standard SLA.

Attached is the one-page amendment and the DocuSign link to sign. Please reply with which option you prefer and whether you want the SLA routing enabled. Once signed, we’ll enable the uplift at midnight PT.

Thanks and congrats on the launch — we’ll be standing by.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: provisional-amendment-draft.pdf (PDF)]
